$comment: Provider pack: Microsoft Playwright MCP for general logged-in web work (accessibility-snapshot driven, token-cheap; opencode is a documented client). Deep-merged by deploy/merge-packs.mjs when --enable-pack playwright (v2 shape: mcp.servers.<name>.disabled:false + permissions array rule). Server definition incl. timeout lives in the base opencode.json; this pack only flips disabled + appends the allow. Requires npx (ships with npm). Self-installs on first spawn.
